name: Roth.isPrimitive_pow
signature:
private lemma isPrimitive_pow {p : Polynomial ℤ} (hp : p.IsPrimitive) (t : ℕ) :
    (p ^ t).IsPrimitive
body: Nat.rec Polynomial.isPrimitive_one (fun t ih ↦ by simpa [pow_succ] using ih.mul hp) t
what: Every natural power of a primitive integer polynomial is primitive.
how: Induct on the exponent using Polynomial.isPrimitive_one and primitive-product closure.
